limits: Pure in-memory sequential reference model; not PostgreSQL execution or a concurrent memory-model proof.
The model assumes an atomic idempotent remote sink and deterministic clocks; PostgreSQL MVCC, network partitions and real sink semantics are not qualified.
5,040 permutations test lifecycle-operation orderings, not probabilities or production reliability.
The SQL reference contract still requires execution against a pinned PostgreSQL version and multi-process stress tests.

source.qualification: Locally executed deterministic model plus 5,040 operation orderings. Not PostgreSQL, multi-process concurrency or live sink qualification.
